about.en: HSBC Holdings plc is a London-headquartered banking and financial services group with wealth, personal, commercial and investment banking businesses, centred on Hong Kong and the UK. HSBC represents its NYSE-listed American depositary shares, each of which stands for five ordinary shares, and in derivative markets HSBC is the reference equity for products tracking those depositary shares rather than the London (HSBA) or Hong Kong (0005) ordinary shares.
